definitions.explanation: A protective covering worn over the nose and mouth to prevent the spread of germs or protect against allergens and pollution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ひいた→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧マスク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm wearing a mask because I have a cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧マスク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かせない：24096_kakasenai⟧。
examples.english: Masks are essential during pollen season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧マスク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}した→外す：02394_hazusu⟧。
examples.english: I took off my mask on the train.

notes:
USAGE:
- Mask-wearing in Japan was common even before COVID-19, especially during cold/flu season and pollen season.
- Often worn as a courtesy when sick, to prevent spreading germs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マスク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧/⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to put on a mask)
- マスク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧ (to take off a mask)
- ⟦{使|つか}い{捨|す}て→使い捨て：07665_tsukaisute⟧マスク (disposable mask)
- ⟦{不織布|ふしょくふ}→不織布：28792_fushokufu⟧マスク (non-woven mask)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Some people also wear masks to hide their face when they don't feel presentable or don't want to be recognized.
